title: Publish latest build (go live)

requirements.text: Publish/deploy the current latest build of the Foam Daddy Storefront so it is publicly accessible via a live URL.
acceptanceCriteria: A live/public URL is available for the latest build.
Visiting the live URL loads the storefront without requiring authentication.
The deployed app renders without blank screens or console errors on initial load.

requirements.text: Post-deploy, verify that the existing Share button copies the correct live URL derived from the deployed environment (window.location.origin + window.location.pathname).
acceptanceCriteria: On the live deployment, clicking “Share” copies a URL that matches the current deployed origin and path.
The UI shows a success toast when copying succeeds and an error toast when copying fails.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: No new product, order, quote, or admin features.
No redesign or visual theme changes unless required to resolve a deployment-blocking issue.
